commit.message:
Extract exact model prompts into versioned resources (#35)

## Summary

Little Say's model instructions and starter messages are embedded in
business logic, making prompt changes difficult to find and review. This
moves the existing text into documented top-level JSON resources with
typed validation and literal substitution. Models receive the same
requests, and parents see the same presets and behavior.

Server prompts stay server-only; shared presets use the existing
Node/Expo loading paths. Account exports are preserved. Deferred ChatGPT
grants in PR20 remain outside this change.

Closes #23.

## Test plan and behavior evidence

| Scenario | Expected and observed | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Run matching synthetic requests on actual master and the extracted
resources, including Unicode, quotes, dollar signs, braces and newlines.
| Complete serialized payloads and starter/preset outputs are
byte-identical across affected operations, picture styles, speech
languages and model selections. | [Fresh Before/After
captures](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/49195f9dd70ce9a9842c460e57348c3d73935cb2/comparison.json)
|
| Load source and source-free ESM; export web, iOS and Android. | All
three exports pass. Client bundles contain shared presets and exclude
server-prompt markers. The relocated production server returns HTTP 200
with AI disabled; invalid resources/substitutions fail clearly. |
[Runtime and bundle
checks](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/49195f9dd70ce9a9842c460e57348c3d73935cb2/runtime-report.json)
|
| Create/refine starter boards and conversations with mocked providers,
including cancellation and failed saves. | All 17 Chromium scenarios
pass; prompts, drafts, consent and recovery remain intact. | [Browser
results](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/49195f9dd70ce9a9842c460e57348c3d73935cb2/oct09-browser.log)
|

This is a non-UI extraction with unchanged request behavior; exact
payload comparison is its observable Before/After contract. Fresh
captures compare actual master `18aa7c0` with final source `29e8fa8c`.
[Source, harness and artifact
identities](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/49195f9dd70ce9a9842c460e57348c3d73935cb2/manifest.json)
and [applicability/retained
originals](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/49195f9dd70ce9a9842c460e57348c3d73935cb2/applicability.json)
are preserved outside product history.

## Supporting checks and limitations

`npm run check` passed: metadata, types, 320 tests, server build and web
export. The merged runtime dependency supports passing iOS and Android
exports. [Current-revision
CI](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/actions/runs/37870046517)
and revision-scoped independent QA are recorded separately. The bot
[declined this revision's review solely for
quota](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/pull/35#issuecomment-6072402436);
no completed bot review is claimed.

Docker engine execution remains unperformed; its unchanged dist-copy
contract and relocated runtime were checked. Native-device testing is
deferred. No signed build, live inference, release or deployment was
performed.

---------

Co-authored-by: Codex <codex@openai.com>

commit.message:
Fix release Auth emulator validation and add manual branch validation (#46)

## Summary

Cut release fails when its integration command runs without the required
Firebase Auth emulator. Current master includes the merged
prompt-resource extraction but retains that direct call. Reuse the
maintained demo-emulator wrapper while keeping every PostgreSQL and
authentication test mandatory.

A manual **validation_only** option runs the same source-validation
boundary on a selected branch with disposable PostgreSQL. It uses
read-only checkout permissions without persisted credentials; every
candidate, registry and provider/release job is excluded. Normal
releases remain restricted to master. Existing PR CI is unchanged.

Closes #45.

## Test plan

- **Current base to proposed source:** after integrating master
`7688118`, the [exact-head validation-only
run](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/actions/runs/37872957939/job/113634941431)
passed **325 unit tests, all 25 PostgreSQL/Auth integration tests, types
and builds**, including source-free prompt-bundle coverage.
Emulator/database cleanup completed; all six release jobs were skipped.
- **Affected runtime and failure boundaries:** 11 targeted local tests
passed for prompt payloads, resources, source-free ESM execution and
validation guards. The original six missing-emulator failures,
regression rejection of the old command, and real local failure/cleanup
evidence remain applicable to unchanged validation code. [Actual-base
impact analysis, raw results and preserved original
body](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/67ca22a9dbb9b7f31bd73e5145b394529455c8cf/impact-master7688118/README.md).

[Current PR CI
passed](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/actions/runs/37872940191),
including five account-browser scenarios. The prior review-bot [quota
refusal](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/pull/46#issuecomment-6072598630)
is retained; it is not a completed review of this head. Independent
review/QA remains required.

This non-UI change validates the real source-check boundary, **not a
complete release**: candidate creation/retirement, signing, providers,
publishing and deployment were not exercised. PR42's retained evidence
covered normal CI and release safeguards but missed this separate
command path. Earlier run37871534382 remains evidence for its original
source, not the new combined build.

Co-authored-by: Codex <codex@openai.com>

 Run **Cut release** in GitHub Actions on the repository default branch (`master`). It plans changes, prepares a protected version PR, and publishes the selected GHCR image, EAS cloud builds, store submissions, and compatible OTA updates. Merges run CI only. Server deployment and device installation remain separate local operations.
 
+To validate a proposed change before merging, select its branch and enable **validation_only** in the same manual workflow. Only the read-only validation job runs: it checks out the exact run SHA without persisted credentials, runs repository checks/builds, and runs all integration tests with disposable PostgreSQL and the local `demo-little-say` Auth emulator. Emulator startup or test failure fails validation; the wrapper stops the emulator afterward. No release credentials, registry login, candidate preparation/retirement, signing, publishing or deployment runs in this mode. Normal release jobs remain restricted to the default branch through preparation. This is source validation, not proof of provider or publication behavior; `dry_run` is a separate release-planning mode with provider prerequisites.
